title: chaenomeles japonica
intro: Chaenomeles japonica, commonly known as the Japanese quince, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, characterized by its fragrant white flowers and edible fruit. The health benefits of Chaenomeles japonica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Chaenomeles japonica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
